This prospective study enrolled 397 White and non-White youth with type 1 (72%) and type 2 (28%) diabetes at diabetes care visits.

output.attribution_rationale: Prior exam completion is compared with completion after point-of-care AI implementation, so AI and the change in access are not separated.

achieved_dates.note: The entry has no achieved dates, and the abstract provides no study dates; publication does not establish when screening occurred.

conflict.note: The supplied abstract discloses no vendor relationships or funding; the registry information mentioned in the entry was not supplied.

tests.note: The abstract gives no dates for the examinations; it also does not establish a study design that clearly meets an evidence-grade category.

output.summary: The abstract supports the reported completion percentages and enrollment, with prior examination completion as a benchmark for the point-of-care AI package. It does not establish achieved dates, isolate AI from improved access, or provide enough design information for a confident evidence grade.
